title.narrative: Driving Womenâ€™s Economic Empowerment (DWEE) in remote and slum areas of five districts in Pakistan

description.narrative: By March 2025, 4,241 marginalised women will achieve sustainable livelihoods, making them and their families (25,000 people) resilient against multidimensional poverty in five districts of Punjab and Karachi. 5,964 women will receive a gender-sensitive package of training and support to enter employment and 1,392 women microentrepreneurs will be supported to grow their businesses sustainably beyond the project.
British Asian Trust UK Aid Match grant towards the Driving Women's Economic Empowerment Programme (DWEE) in Pakistan.
